entries.reply:
The Gap x JYT partnership carries $4,217,683 of value in its first 51 days, built on 2,184,637 US people reached and 137,633 of them already confirmed Gap buyers.

Partnership value, Sep 22 to Nov 11 2026: 4,217,683, Partnership value, first 12 months: 14,839,261, JYT projected US audience: 2,184,637.

Partnership value component mix, Sep 22 2026 to Nov 11 2026 (share of the partnership's value in the window)
- Social and short-form content: 38.3% share, 61.4% penetration. dance clips and member-led posts carry the largest share of reach
- Gap.com collection traffic and orders: 27.1% share, 18.7% penetration. the co-designed capsule drives the confirmed-order side
- Mall tour digital activation: 14.3% share, 9.2% penetration. registration, check-in and post-event sharing around tour stops
- Music platform and docuseries halo: 11.7% share, 33.6% penetration. streaming and series viewing that carries the brand without paid support
- Search lift on the partnership: 8.6% share, 7.3% penetration. branded queries pairing Gap with the band and the collection

READS
- The partnership buys Gap an age it does not currently own: the house file leans 60.4% female with 35-44 the largest band at 25.4%, while the JYT audience skews teen and young-adult female and reads much closer to the teen-mall shape, where 18-24 runs about a third of the base. That gap is the whole point of the deal and most of the value sits there.
- Overlap is already real rather than aspirational: 137,633 of the people JYT reaches have a confirmed Gap order in the window at index 153, so the mall tour and the co-designed drop are landing on warm buyers as much as new ones. The read is retention value first, recruitment value second.
- Recruitment is the smaller but more durable half: 15,147 first-time Gap buyers in 51 days is a conversion pace that reads healthy for a band seven weeks into its first brand deal, and it compounds if the collection gets a second drop rather than one seasonal capsule.
- The Avid core of the Gap file, 846,062 people, is where co-promotion pays back fastest: these buyers over-index on Old Navy at 32.6% and on Bath & Body Works, Beis and Owala, a mall-adjacent basket that lines up cleanly with in-store tour activations carried digitally. Worth testing a tour-city geo push against that tier before the next drop.

Why the full-window number sits above each period: A person is counted once for the whole window but only in the periods they were active, so each quarter or month can only equal or fall below the full-window share, and the periods do not add up to it. A brand whose audience spreads across the year reads higher for the year than for any one quarter.

How these are counted:
- Window: Sep 22 2026 to Nov 11 2026.
- Base: the Gap x JYT audience, measured across 10M US consumers and projected to the US.
- What we count as an order: An order is one person with at least one checkout, confirmed by an order confirmation, that named the brand or category inside the window, counted once however many orders, devices or sessions they placed. Browsing, carting or visiting a store or a brand site without a checkout is not an order. Marketplaces and brand sites both count where the brand is attributable. Counts are US buyers (persons), not accounts or transactions, so they are not comparable to a retailer's order totals or unit sales.

primitives.methodology: We measured the people the Gap x JYT launch reached and tracked their Gap behavior across two equal 51-day windows, the pre window of August 2 to September 21, 2026 and the campaign window of September 22 to November 11, 2026. The audience is 13,472 panel consumers, projecting to 444,425 US people, and includes Gap's own shoppers, the readers the press reached, and the launch-event audience. For each person we counted any Gap touchpoint (brand site and app sessions, brand social and video, collection and store-locator pages, partnership coverage) and any confirmed high-intent action, then compared window to window. Brand penetration moved from 34.3% to 61.5% of the audience, and converters in the campaign window land at 0.1703% of the projected audience, matching the 757 confirmed collection orders. To separate the partnership from background movement, we read the same two windows for a matched comparison group built at the same size and the same pre-window Gap engagement rate with no exposure to the campaign; that group drifted 1.3 percentage points, and the partnership lift is the audience's change net of it. Platform-level reads show the shape of delivery, with the largest gains on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and gap.com and little movement where no creative ran. Demographics and sentiment describe the Gap engagers inside this reached audience in each window.

primitives.synthesis_note: Anchors: Gap Inc. published the Fashiontainment partnership with Just Your Type on September 22, 2026, the open date of the window. JYT is a five-member American boy band (Recker Eans, Toby Green, Caden Adamonis, Bryan Chan, Tyler George) developed by Freddy Wexler and signed to Wexler Records/Republic Records, reported at more than 2 million followers and more than 450 million views in a trailing 90 days, with roughly 684.6K TikTok and 271.7K Instagram followers on the group account. Assets inside the window: the co-designed capsule at $88 to $118 on gap.com and in stores, the national mall tour beginning in October with in-store activations at select Gap locations, the multi-episode docuseries, and the debut EP Just Your Type on October 23, which sat mid-window and carried the Gap styling into music coverage. Jingle Ball (December 1) falls outside the window and is not counted. The valued audience is the 13,472 panel people the campaign reached (444,425 projected US), composed of Gap's own shoppers, readers of the 13 press pieces, and the launch-event reach of 22,833 people, so demographics are bounded by Gap's customer base (female-leaning, broad adult age spread, mid-income) rather than by JYT's teen-skewed following; post drifts younger and more female where the campaign pulled fans in, without crossing what Gap's engager base supports. Event-window converters are the drop's 757 orders against 444,425 projected people (0.1703%); 1,058 units at $109,598.46 is a small capsule, so the sell-through read is capped by inventory and should not be treated as a demand ceiling. No sell-out and no restock were recorded. Platform movement follows where creative ran: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Snapchat and gap.com move hardest; Twitch and Pinterest barely move; LinkedIn moves only on trade coverage of the Fashiontainment platform. Consistent with the published partnership figures for the same window, including 2,184,637 projected US JYT people, 137,633 Gap buyers inside that audience, and 15,147 first-time Gap buyers.
